Codebase ingested.

Lore has built a persistent knowledge graph of your repository. You can now interrogate its entire history — decisions, context, and reasoning — across infinite sessions.

Open Interrogation Room → View Memory Graph
What gets ingested

All commit messages and diffs, pull request titles, bodies, and review comments, issue descriptions and comment threads, and repository README and docs.

How memory works

Cognee structures everything into a hybrid graph-vector store. Relationships between contributors, decisions, and code are permanently mapped and queryable.
